defects.claim: Wallpaper lattice collapse test uses an absolute cell-area threshold, so a small but regular lattice is treated as collapsed and all copies are suppressed
defects.scenario: Scale a lattice with perpendicular axes and its extent down uniformly; the cell area drops below the absolute threshold and no copies draw, though few copies would be visible

defects.claim: Baking rounds a real authored scale below 1e-12 to zero, leaving a singular baked pose
defects.scenario: Bake symmetry on a node whose pose has a nonzero scale below 1e-12; the baked pose is singular while the live copy still draws with nonzero scale
defects.cause: cleanup applied to authored coefficients, not just round-off
